note: Prices and free allowances as published on the provider pages on the date above. They change; re-read before relying on them. Nothing here is a quote or a commitment.

b2.egress: free up to 3x the average monthly storage, then 0.01 USD per GB
b2.requests: class A, B and C free; class D 0.004 USD per 10,000 with 2,500 per day free
b2.minimums: no minimum object size and no minimum storage duration stated

scaleway.egress: 75 GB free per month, then 0.01 EUR per GB
scaleway.minimums: billed per started GB-hour: the page's own example bills 1 KB stored for 1 second as 1 GB-hour, so a bucket far below 1 GB should be expected to bill about one GB of storage (about 0.016 EUR a month)

r2.requests: class A 4.50 USD per million, class B 0.36 USD per million; DeleteObject and AbortMultipartUpload free
